title: Bleach Takes Over Japan With Special Promo Ahead of Anime Finale – Watch
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is nearing closer than ever to the release of the anime’s final episodes ever, and it has taken over Japan with a cool new promo to get fans ready for the grand finale. Bleach made its return earlier this Summer with the final wave of episodes to bring its anime to an ultimate end.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Creator Returns With New Look at Asta’s Wizard King Makeover
content: Black Clover ‘s creator has returned with a new look at Asta’s Wizard King makeover following the manga’s original finale, and it’s to get ready for a cool new art book release coming to Japan soon.
author: ComicBook

title: Naruto Card Game Shows Off Dream Fights in Special Anime Trailer – Watch
content: Naruto is gearing up to make its official card game debut next year, and it is showing off some of the dream match ups that fans will be able to make happen with a special new trailer from the original studio behind the Naruto anime.
author: ComicBook

title: 'The Fable 2nd Season' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the The Fable television anime revealed additional cast and the main visual (pictured) for its second season on Wednesday. The new season will adapt the Yamaoka-hen ( Yamaoka Arc ) from Katsuhisa Minami 's crime comedy manga and is scheduled to premiere on the Nippon TV network on January 10,…
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Fable Season 2 TV Anime Reveals More Cast, January 9 Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Katsuhisa Minami 's The Fable manga announced on Wednesday six cast members and the January 9 premiere for the anime's second season .
author: ANN

title: Major Crunchyroll Isekai Finally Drops English Dub for Its Big Movie After 7 Years
content: A major Crunchyroll isekai has finally dropped its English dub release for the anime’s big movie seven long years after its initial release. It’s been a big year for Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil.
author: ComicBook

title: South Park Brings Back Kyle & Ike With New Season 29 Episode First Look Trailer – Watch Now
content: South Park Season 29 is back with a new episode this week, and the first look trailer is teasing a new story for Kyle and Ike. South Park Season 29 has made some big adjustments to the way it has been telling its stories compared to last year with a renewed focus on the town and boys themselves .
author: ComicBook

title: Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance Anime Film's Trailer Reveals Theme Song
content: The official website for Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance (Heart's Resonance), the all-new feature-length anime film sequel to the Expelled from Paradise film, began streaming on Tuesday a trailer, and it reveals and previews the theme song "Beyond the Night" by TeddyLoid feat.
author: ANN

title: 'Kusuriya no Hitorigoto' Movie Reveals Additional Cast, Character Trailers
content: The official website for the Kusuriya no Hitorigoto anime series revealed the additional cast and two character trailers for the anime movie on Tuesday. The movie, subtitled Bouhi no Hihou ( The Secret Treasure of the Deceased Consort ), opens in Japanese theaters on December 11.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Talent Agency Intention Announces Dissolution on March 31, 2027
content: The company added that management operations will continue normally until its dissolution, and that it will give the utmost support for its affiliated talents' future. Intention announced in June that Suzumura would gradually return to voice acting work after going on hiatus in February earlier this year.
author: ANN
